steps.en: PLUS asks OCMS to permanently suspend unpaid notices
steps.id: PLUS meminta OCMS men-suspend permanen notice yang belum dibayar

steps.en: The permanent suspension is applied on the unpaid notice
steps.id: Suspension permanen diterapkan pada notice yang belum dibayar

steps.en: PLUS receives a message that the suspension succeeded
steps.id: PLUS menerima pesan bahwa suspension berhasil
